part.text:
The robot is now close to the red ball and facing it. The ball is straight ahead, roughly 25 cm away. I called `rest`, and the robot is crouched with its motors off.

I found the ball after a few sweeps of the room. The last camera view still shows it directly ahead and very near the feet.
